scope: Exact older Realtek WB firmware rows 5, 6, and 16 only; source-local bounded emulator state, not device, boot, typed-AC, or physical-effect claims.

provenance.source_hashes: Each canonical source SHA-256 and embedded HID below is independently source-qualified; raw table counts and operation contracts are per source.

wire.generic_framing: Rows5/6/16 normal inner JSON ends at '}' without trailing LF; the SDK may put an optional pretty-print LF before that final brace. The dispatcher copies the exact callback length and AES-ECB adds only PKCS7 padding. Generic outer UDP JSON has no LF; row6 statusCheck is the sole outer-LF-after-encryption exception, but this model rejects its unsafe timestamp/send branch atomically.

key_selector.0: Per-device private key from the local context.
key_selector.1: Exact source key a3K8Bx%2r8Y7#xDh independently established for each listed image.

cipher_source_proof.selector: Numeric outer i=0 selects private key; i=1 selects generic key; Replies reuse request i/key.

generic_key.row_16: GetScanKey 0x9b01fd5c assembles eight constant halfwords from original initialized data at 0x100011c0..0x100011dc to spell a3K8Bx%2r8Y7#xDh; no UID, MMIO, or runtime-input dependency.

wire.reply_route: The profile returns a logical Reply preserving i/uid, setting cid to the virtual device MAC and tcid from request cid; rows5/16 retain peer/source-port routing. Row6 Replies are explicitly routed by the emulator server to 255.255.255.255:5000 via the separate native sender socket contract. The native UDP dispatcher does not enforce tcid or inner-MAC equality.
wire.actual_mid: The source dev/tdev MID is separate from the property getter mid buffer and device.mid. A configured virtual mcu_mid_raw uint32 emits lowercase hex; zero uses the source case-4 retry fallback 10001 after retry count exceeds five. This is a source-qualified virtual input, not a universal physical appliance identity.
wire.hid: The embedded firmware literal is returned from the profile, and is not a user-overridable runtime alias.
wire.tdev_lock: Native tdev builder emits numeric literal zero, independent of the status lock getter and UBind lock readout.
wire.status_mid: The status mid getter reads its own synthetic NUL-text property buffer, default empty; it never aliases the advertised dev MID.

raw_names.matching: Exact case-sensitive first property-table match; request order and duplicates are preserved. NoD is a numeric raw field, not a global skip.
raw_names.status: Metadata values precede numeric cache values; DevID and MafIdf keep their requested cols but append no dat element. Unknown columns do not fabricate zero values.
raw_names.numeric_storage: First matching numeric cache word stores low16; valid cmd numeric p echoes the parsed signed request word, not the narrowed stored cache. Special getters remain separate from write-cache slots.

numeric_abi.accepted_tokens: For rows 5/6/16 cmd p, only positive digit-start numeric tokens without a decimal point reach the numeric helper (source tag 2); negative integers, fractions, quoted strings, booleans, and null do not convert. Positive exponent tokens such as 1e3 reach the helper as tag 2.
numeric_abi.conversion: The source-local helper consumes a decimal digit prefix into wrapping signed int32, with no overflow or full-token check; static p:[1e3] conversion is 1. The model atomically rejects non-tag-2 values rather than reproducing unsafe native count/shift behavior.
numeric_abi.ack: Valid numeric cmd p is formatted from signed parsed int32 words, while first-match cache stores low16; source string/no-op/readback branches remain separate.

chosen_virtual_readouts.tdev_name_alias: Rows 5/6 status name getters and tdev name share context+0x174; row16 shares context+0x170. The chosen context name is explicit virtual text, not a recovered boot default.

row_16_time_words.policy: Chosen virtual readouts, not recovered constructor values; persistence occurs only when gate > 0x5b03b45b and updates (old offset + new epoch - old clock) modulo 2^32.

chosen_virtual_readouts.policy: Cold primary bc/vender readouts are empty and tdev fields alias those same status getters; only source-gated 0x44 input populates vender, while LAN numeric vender commands only write their shadow cache. Cold GnetID/mode defaults are zero; row5/6 primary/tdev version becomes V3.4.MF4 only after its source-specific gate passes, with cold version V3.4.M; row16 version is V3.0.0. UBind always uses the companion version.

special_getters.row_5_6_modeltype: Numeric first-match cache field; no string getter.
special_getters.row_5_ver: Companion-version readout when GnetID is nonzero; otherwise module-version readout.
special_getters.row_6_ver: Companion-version readout when MCU mode equals two; otherwise module-version readout.
special_getters.row_16_ver: Module-version text getter, separate from emitted dev version.

schedules.all_rows: setT replaces matching ID or inserts at list head below count 10; updateT replaces only an existing node but ACKs a missing ID; queryT scans numeric IDs 0 through 9 and skips holes; deleteT decrements the count even when missing and a non-head match drops the preceding linked-list prefix.
schedules.record: Enable 1 stores 0 and other numeric values store 1; query inverts the stored byte. Week consumes seven numeric values as bit contributions. Successful sec parsing stores zero; tz is parsed and ignored. Only the first nested cmd object is consumed; Pow has a source-local numeric byte mapping. Initial setT delta uses modulo 86400; an HR time update recalculates only stored-byte-1 records to signed targetSeconds-currentSeconds without modulo.
schedules.numeric_lexing: Rows5/6/16 schedule scalar and array helpers accept signed integers and decimal fractions, truncate toward zero, and wrap to signed int32. Scalar 1e3 yields 1; array 1e3 may split into 1,3 because the next helper blindly skips one separator byte. Arrays consume only caller-expected values; malformed records are rejected atomically.
schedules.safe_bounds: Malformed schedule records are rejected atomically rather than inheriting native partial/zero records or failed-seconds prior-temporary reuse. Query pages and nested opt/p arrays are bounded; schedule effects remain local with no task-registration, physical-actuation, or reboot-persistence claim.

local_operation_edges.upgrade: Rows5/6/16 use SDK text tokens, accept quoted strings and literal null/true/false, cap at 119 bytes, and emit only a local intent ACK; missing/invalid/too-long URL is rejected without a reply and no OTA runs.
local_operation_edges.time: Rows5/6 ignore the supplied text, persist their source-specific flags and acknowledge the unchanged clock. Row16 parses/updates the virtual RTC, recalculates only schedule nodes whose stored enable byte is 1 using a signed delta, and conditionally persists modulo-32-bit clock-offset delta when global gate word 0x10009c50 exceeds 0x5b03b45b; ACK p is the current-clock getter.
local_operation_edges.scan: Rows5/6 encrypted scan UBind is gated by GnetID!=0 and MCU mode==2 respectively; cold defaults are zero. UBind emits companion version, signed-int8 lock, configured private devkey and numeric scene 0.
local_operation_edges.report_ctrl: Rows5/6 accept actual boolean reportAnyway; nonboolean values are ignored. A slashless configured context is rejected atomically instead of reaching the native unsafe prefix path.
local_operation_edges.network_info: Row6 reads eight raw gnetkey bytes (not hex-decoded bytes); the virtual model requires eight available bytes and has no external network effect.

atomic_rejection: reset response depends on an unresolved constant string pointer 0xc8
statusCheck has an unsafe timestamp pointer and broadcast send
nonzero loginInfoRes GnetID enters a native double-free path
binCmd scene-fragment handling has unbounded native writes and an unqualified application schema
bounded_storage: ReportClientID frame text is capped at 26 bytes
binCmd validates base64, 0x7e7e marker, staged frame length, and 60-byte copy bound
UBind requires three explicitly configured 12-hex virtual identities and the 512-byte source-local envelope bound
ReportLimit NRA accepts one to sixteen rows of exactly three numeric values
safe_model_deviations.no_external_effects: Device-originated UART/GPIO/OTA/network operations only record local state or intent; protocol Replies use the emulator server's source-qualified route, including row6 broadcast. No device/cloud/BLE facade, physical GPIO/UART action, firmware download, or flash operation is performed.

row_17.admission: Row17 source identity and ECB/GCM key schedule are qualified, but its authenticated source-visible ingress is MQTT/TLS callbacks that force mode1; no UDP bind/recvfrom/registered UDP receiver exists. No exact row17 LAN profile is admitted without a source-compatible UDP registration/receiver path.

verification: Focused tests are specified but intentionally not executed by the worker. No build, tests, formatter, lint, runtime, device, network, or flash verification is claimed.
